text:
marta: Kicking off Q4 launch planning thread. Main asks: 1) PLG onboarding experiment for free tier, 2) Sales enablement pack for Dedicated customers, 3) a short paid pilot offer. Need rough targets, launch criteria, and owner volunteers.

sam: quick q — do we have a revenue target tied to the pilot, or is it more of a lead-gen/foot-in-door play?

lina: For PLG experiment I want to prioritize activation -> 7 day DAU and feature adoption (embeddings endpoint). Hypothesis: tweak onboarding to get 3x trial-to-usage.

noah: Product constraints: embeddings infra will be limited for the first 2 weeks of the experiment unless we carve capacity. We can provide throttles + queuing.

arun: We could spin a small dedicated pool for the pilot (2x A10Gs) for test accounts, but needs budget sign-off. Latency should be fine.

jen: Enablement perspective: we need 1) sales one-pager, 2) two demo decks (self-serve vs. Dedicated), 3) FAQ for security/compliance. I can draft but will need product SMEs.

marta: Sam — propose we treat pilot as a qualifying revenue target: $75k ARR pipeline target within 90 days of pilot start, measured by committed pilots. Thoughts?

sam: Sounds reasonable as a stretch. Can we tier it: baseline $40k expected, $75k stretch? That helps quota planning.

lina: PLG experiments should not be blocked by revenue; keep separate OKRs. PLG OKR: increase trial->paid conversion by 2.5x for teams using the new onboarding flow.

noah: Launch criteria proposal (product):
- onboarding flow implemented and A/B ready
- telemetry to track activation funnel events
- fallback plan if embeddings capacity hits 80%
- security signoff for data retention

marta: Nice. Add marketing launch criteria:
- lead list and nurture campaign ready
- 2 webinar dates scheduled
- launch assets: blog, email sequence, demo videos

arun: FYI from infra: if we opt for dedicated test pool we need the ticket by 09/18 to guarantee hardware by early Oct.

marta: timeline suggestion:
- 09/18: product API freeze for onboarding changes
- 09/25: enablement assets first drafts
- 10/02: internal sales training + dry run
- 10/09: pilot begins (limited cohort)

sam: Can we get a separate enablement slot for strategic accounts? Some sales reps want deeper compliance slides.

jen: Yes — I'll prepare an appendix with compliance Qs and a one-pager for strategic sellers. Need product SMEs @noah @arun to review.

noah: I'll review the compliance appendix by 09/22 and provide wording for retention/keys.

lina: Quick PLG experiment idea: add an in-app prompt that offers a 14-day burst of Dedicated-like throughput for free for teams that complete an onboarding checklist. Measure adoption and conversion.

arun: That requires routing and temporary capacity policies but doable. Need list of allowed accounts and automated cutover.

marta: Action items (quick):
- marta: finalize launch brief by 09/15
- noah: telemetry + compliance wording by 09/22
- jen: enablement drafts by 09/25
- arun: infra capacity decision and ticket by 09/18
- sam: sales cohort list and quota tiering by 09/20
- lina: PLG experiment spec + measurement plan by 09/19

sam: I'll pull the cohort list and share a CSV to this thread by EOD 09/20.

deploy-bot: Reminder: #infra-request template submitted for "Q4 pilot pool". Ticket ID INF-7241. Status: awaiting approval. :gear:

marta: Nice — can someone volunteer to run the pilot retrospective and metrics review at +30 days after pilot start?

lina: I'll own the retrospective and measurement dashboard.

sam: I'll help with the win/regression stories and customer quotes.

marta: One more negotiation note — product is pushing to keep the initial pilot scope small (no advanced routing, no A/B more than 2 variants). GTM would like more surface to sell. Can we agree on gated rollout: start small, enable extended feature set in week 3 if metrics good?

noah: Agree to gated rollout. We'll codify a "go/no-go" checklist for week 2. If activation < target, we hold additional features.

jen: For enablement timeline, assume gated rollout, we'll prepare materials for both minimal and extended feature sets so sales can be ready.

marta: Great. If there are no objections, I'll lock this plan into the Q4 GTM board and start assigning tasks. We'll keep this thread for updates.

arun: No objections from infra. We'll push the capacity ticket.

sam: 👍 thanks all.

marta: Thanks — tagging @here for visibility.
